sections.heading: "AI for sellers: open the design-system conversation" (60 min)
sections.text:
Built from: Raquel's own AI workshop, adapted with Nagarro examples.
Who: client managers, account managers, presales.
Rollout by region:
1. North America first, before Experience Day if possible.
2. DACH
3. UK & Nordics
4. Middle East & India

Each session is recorded. Refresh quarterly.

What sellers leave with:
- a 1-page battle card
- a demo they can run alone in 10 minutes
- the problem-form link
- the "Ask the account" route

sections.heading: Agenda
sections.text:
Min · Block · Content

0–5 · Hook · Two AI screens from the same prompt: "Which one is your client's product?"
5–15 · Why clients care now · Agents build UI → drift, rework, brand and accessibility risk. One line on each of the 6 triggers
15–25 · What we sell, in plain words · Scorecard → readout → 2-week AI audit → DS Build / Accelerate / Scale / Support. One proof per package
25–35 · The demo you can run alone · Live on the demo brand: blind prompt → with system → fake token refused. Sellers repeat it in pairs
35–50 · Hands-on (from Raquel's workshop) · Each seller uses Claude to prepare a one-page account brief for a real account: public product screens, likely AI use, which trigger applies, 3 discovery questions. *This is the part that makes them come.*
50–58 · Objections, role-play · Two pairs play "Client says: we already have a design system" and "We don't have budget for this"
58–60 · How to bring us in · Problem form · Ask the account (48 h) · office hours · Teams channel

sections.heading: Hands-on prompt (sellers paste it into Claude)
sections.text:
> I'm preparing for a conversation with {client}, a {industry} company in {market}. Using only public information (their website, apps, job posts, press), list: (1) the digital products they run, (2) signs they use AI to build or design software, (3) which of these triggers apply: AI coding rollout, rebrand or M&A, re-platform, accessibility regulation (EAA), inconsistent UI across products, small design team; (4) three open questions I could ask their head of design or CTO about AI and their design system. Be explicit about what is a guess.

Rule: sellers use only public information, with no confidential client data in prompts. Remind them of Nagarro's AI usage policy.

sections.heading: After the session
sections.text:
- Office hours: weekly 30 min (Raquel or a DS ambassador).
- A Teams channel, "Ask the DS practice".
- Each seller commits to sending the problem form to 2 accounts within 2 weeks. Track this in the problem bank under client manager.
